label: ApproveWorkspace
prompt: Style document submissions as a calm review workspace with version-first rows, clear due dates, and labeled pending or decided states. Give exact files and decision reasons prominence; keep review history secondary but accessible. Keep daisyUI theme and shared shell defaults, canonical permissions/actions, localized labels, complete forms/errors, visible keyboard focus, and responsive stacking. Apply consistently to each styled page content scope; keep page admission and the shared shell unchanged.
